name: Shaper Priest
description: Clergy of the Shaper Church who guide Tezcat in spiritual and worldly matters, proselytise the faith and punish the sinful. A Tezcat career (Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 4).

academic.name: Academic
academic.description: You pursue your faith through study and further understanding of the world around you.

ecclesiastic.name: Ecclesiastic
ecclesiastic.description: You bring the teachings of the church to your followers.

partisan.name: Partisan
partisan.description: You are the military arm of the church — enforcing its laws and defending the faith.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table, but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: Good works in the community earn you wide respect. Gain SOC +1 and an Ally.
events.4: A notable academic consults you for a publication or documentary. Gain a Contact in academia.
events.5: You are sent to preach Shaper doctrine among the poor of a new parish. Gain either Streetwise or Persuade.
events.6: You retreat from the mundane world seeking revelation, neglecting your work and relationships. Lose SOC -D3 but gain D3 Benefit rolls and DM+1 on these and all future Benefit rolls.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: You represent the Shaper Church in a highly public forum. Gain either Carouse or Persuade.
events.9: You are offered inducements to betray the Shaper Church. Accept and you must leave this career and lose all Benefit rolls, but gain Cr10000×2D per Benefit roll lost. Refuse and gain 1D Enemies.
events.10: An important personage confides damaging indiscretions to you. Keep their confidence and gain them as an Ally; exploit it and gain them as an Enemy plus D3 additional Benefit rolls.
events.11: Someone more charismatic but less devout becomes your superior. All future Advancement rolls suffer DM-1.
events.12: Your faith enjoys an explosion of popularity thanks to you. You are immediately promoted one grade and gain DM+1 on all future Advancement checks.

mishaps.1: Opponents of your belief system ambush you. Roll on the Injury table and leave this career.
mishaps.2: You guide a follower back to the True Path, angering a friend or relative. Gain an Enemy.
mishaps.3: You are caught in a scandal. Lose 1 rank and a Benefit roll, but you are not ejected from this career.
mishaps.4: You have been following false teachings! Lose 1 skill level from either Profession (religion) or Science (shaper church) and leave this career.
mishaps.5: Your faith is shaken. Lose all Benefit rolls gained so far in this career, but you do not have to leave it.
mishaps.6: You clash with a splinter group of the Shaper Church that calls your version heresy. Gain D3 Rivals.
